title: tvOS: Cancel on the Delete account step sends the focus to Remove on a device row
where: apps/apple/Marquee/Sync/SyncScreen.swift DeleteSync: the row's button is disabled while the step shows (`busy || isTV && asking`), so when Cancel closes the step the focus engine finds no button there and takes the nearest one up the page
effect: a second Select opens Remove for the other device instead of the step again
fix: a FocusState on the row's button, set when Cancel closes the step (as Cancel gets it on open)

title: tvOS: Cancel stays enabled while the delete runs (N1, in part)
where: SyncScreen.swift DeleteSync: only the step's Delete has .disabled(busy)
effect: on this walk the focus stayed on the disabled Deleting, so Select did nothing; Cancel is one Left away and would hide the step while the deletion still lands
fix: .disabled(busy) on Cancel too (the accounts agent is adding it)
